'''2000 Mountain View Grand Slam Sealed Deck''' was a Star Wars CCG Grand Slam held in Mountain View, California on 19 February 2000. [[Mike Mooney]] won it. It is known from Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d283">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-26-mt-view-california-2-19d283/ mt-view-california-2-19], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 26 February 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-26-mt-view-california-2-19d283/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2000 Mountain View Grand Slam]].

* '''Date:''' 19 February 2000
* '''Site:''' Mountain View, California
* '''Winner:''' [[Mike Mooney]]
